Dear Sir / Madam, 
 
Sub: 
Outcome of the Board Meeting held on October 20, 2026 
 
Ref: - Scheme of Amalgamation between Dr. Agarwal’s Eye Hospital Limited and Dr. 
Agarwal’s Health Care Limited and their respective shareholders and creditors 
(“Scheme”) under Sections 230 to 232 and other applicable provisions of the 
Companies Act, 2013 
 
- Regulation 30 of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and 
Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 (“SEBI Listing Regulations”) 
 
In continuation to our earlier letter dated October 05, 2026, intimating the receipt of Sanction 
from the Hon’ble National Company Law Tribunal, Chennai Bench (“NCLT”), towards the 
above referred Scheme and pursuant to the captioned subject & reference, we wish to inform 
that the Board of Directors of Dr. Agarwal’s Health Care Limited (“Company” / “Transferee 
Company”) at its meeting held today, i.e., Tuesday, October 20, 2026, has, inter-alia, noted, 
considered & approved the following:  
 
A. Effectiveness of the Scheme of Amalgamation  
 
The certified copy of the Order dated September 30, 2026, passed by the NCLT, sanctioning 
the Scheme was taken on record. The Board further noted that with the filing of the certified 
copy of the NCLT Order in Form INC-28 with the Registrar of Companies (“ROC”), Chennai on 
October 15, 2026, all conditionalities specified under Clause 24 of the Scheme stand satisfied.  
 
Accordingly, the Scheme shall become effective and operative from November 01, 2026 
(Effective Date), with the Appointed Date being April 01, 2026.  
 
B. Alteration of the Authorized Share Capital of the Company  
 
Pursuant to Clause 21 and 22 of the Scheme and Section 232(3)(i) of the Companies Act, 2013:  
 
Ref: AHCL/2026-27/C047 
October 20, 2026

C. Fixation of Record Date for Allotment of Consideration Shares to the eligible shareholders 
of the Transferor Company pursuant to the Scheme of Amalgamation 
 
In compliance with Regulation 42 of the SEBI Listing Regulations and pursuant to the Scheme, 
the Board of Directors of the Transferee Company, in consultation with the Board of Directors 
of the Transferor Company, has fixed Wednesday, November 18, 2026 as the Record Date for 
determining the eligible equity shareholders of the Transferor Company entitled to receive 
Consideration Shares as per the approved Share Exchange Ratio below:  
 
“23 (Twenty-Three) fully paid-up Equity Shares of face value of ₹1 each of Dr. Agarwal’s 
Health Care Limited for every 2 (Two) fully paid-up Equity Shares of face value of ₹10 each 
held in Dr. Agarwal’s Eye Hospital Limited”
